subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the description-only fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84589 fully satisfy this issue, or is a dynamically derived channel/plugin enum required before closure?
rationale: The description fixes the demonstrated ambiguity with minimal core surface, while enum support establishes a new plugin-aware schema-discovery contract that repository behavior does not currently require.

options.title: Close after description lands
options.body: Accept the narrow metadata and regression-test fix as sufficient, revisiting enum support only if real misuse persists.

options.title: Require plugin-aware enum
options.body: Keep the issue open after the description lands until a lightweight registered-channel value source and focused coverage are added.

recommendation.title: Close after description lands
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow metadata and regression-test fix as sufficient, revisiting enum support only if real misuse persists.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact gap and articulated the description-first, dynamic-enum-only-if-needed boundary.
